definitions.explanation: Fifty percent of the original price. Often seen on sale items and discounted products.

examples.japanese: {半額|はんがく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought it at half price.

examples.japanese: ⟦{閉店|へいてん}→閉店：09698_heiten⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{弁当|べんとう}→弁当：01014_bentou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{半額|はんがく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Bento boxes become half price before closing time.

examples.japanese: {半額|はんがく}⟦セール→セール：07780_seeru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}い→買う：00489_kau⟧すぎてしまった。
examples.english: I ended up buying too many clothes at the half-price sale.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{半|はん}→半：10460_han⟧ (half) + ⟦{額|がく}→額：02607_gaku⟧ (amount). Means exactly 50% of the original price.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {半額|はんがく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to buy at half price
- {半額|はんがく}⟦セール→セール：07780_seeru⟧: half-price sale
- {半額|はんがく}⟦シール→シール：09597_shiiru⟧: half-price sticker
- {半額|はんがく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become half price

CULTURAL NOTE:
Supermarkets often put {半額|はんがく} stickers on ⟦{弁当|べんとう}→弁当：01014_bentou⟧ (bento), ⟦{惣菜|そうざい}→惣菜：05827_souzai⟧ (prepared foods), and ⟦{刺身|さしみ}→刺身：04023_sashimi⟧ (sashimi) near closing time to reduce waste. Bargain-hunting for {半額|はんがく} items is a common practice.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{割引|わりびき}→割引：01526_waribiki⟧: discount (general)
- ⟦{値下|ねさ}げ→値下げ：07583_nesage⟧: price reduction
- ○{割引|わりびき}き: ~% off (e.g., {三割引|さんわりびき} = 30% off)
